summary.text: Steve Southerland is a Republican state senator from Morristown who represents Tennessee Senate District 9 (Cocke, Greene, Hamblen, Sevier and Unicoi counties) and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
A mortgage broker, he serves as Senate Deputy Speaker.

paragraphs.text: Steve Southerland was born on March 8, 1955, and is married to Cheri; the couple has one child.
He attended Walters State Community College and lists his profession as mortgage broker.
Southerland has been a member of the Senate from the 103rd through the 114th General Assemblies and serves as Senate Deputy Speaker and chaplain of the Senate Republican Caucus.
He is second vice-chair of the Senate Commerce and Labor Committee and a member of the Fiscal Review and Government Operations committees.
He is a member of the Morristown Area Chamber of Commerce and Buffalo Trail Baptist Church.
